resources.string: Chat with Nextcloud Talk: read conversations and send messages. New messages appear while this page is open; there is no background connection and there are no notifications. Calls are not included.

Nextcloud address, user name and an app password (Nextcloud: Settings → Security). The Talk app must be installed on the server. HTTPS only. Recommendation: create a separate app password just for the launcher, because it gives access to the whole account and can be revoked individually there.
Signing out deletes the credentials, the key and the encrypted message cache on this device. Everything on the server is kept.
No connection to the server. The stored state is shown.
You cannot write in this conversation.
User name or app password was rejected.
The Talk app was not found on the server.
The password cannot be stored securely on this device.
No Nextcloud account is saved in the FeedReader.
No Nextcloud account is saved in Notes.
The server rejected the credentials. Sign in again under “Nextcloud account”.
The conversation is no longer available.
The messages could not be loaded.
You are not allowed to write in this conversation.
The file is too large (limit 100 MB, the server may allow less).
The file could not be sent. Check the connection and the permissions in your Nextcloud.
